name: awcms-micro-static-analysis
description: Quarantined static-analysis toolchain (Issue #369). Lives in its own node_modules so that `typescript@6` — which `astro check` and `typescript-eslint` still require for TypeScript's programmatic API — never reaches the repository root, which stays on `typescript@7`. Run its binaries with cwd = repository root; see scripts/static-analysis.ts.
